subject.title: Message tool send loops forever when model attaches placeholder location object ("Location sends cannot be combined")

question: For a send containing valid text or media plus a location object, should OpenClaw reject the entire call as documented, discard the location and deliver the text/media, or stop the run with a non-retryable diagnostic while schema work prevents the invalid combination?
rationale: The documented contract forbids mixed location sends, but the report shows frontier models may synthesize placeholder values. Choosing silent recovery versus preserving an explicit validation boundary is a user-visible tool-contract decision.

options.title: Preserve validation; stop retries
options.body: Keep the standalone-location contract, make this semantic error terminal for the run, and improve the schema so models are less likely to construct the invalid combination.

options.title: Deliver text and drop location
options.body: Treat a mixed location as optional noise and send the text or media with a warning, accepting that explicit location intent can be discarded.

options.title: Require an action split first
options.body: Introduce or strengthen discriminated message action schemas before changing runtime error handling, then revisit recovery semantics with observed model behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve validation; stop retries
recommendation.body: Keep the standalone-location contract, make this semantic error terminal for the run, and improve the schema so models are less likely to construct the invalid combination.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent tool-loop guard work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the terminal-retry portion, though direct ownership remains unconfirmed.
